correctness.rationale: Direct elimination of the belief variable gives a scalar level-set H(x), exactly differentiable. H is strictly increasing on the full unit interval up to and including the sharp parameter equality and develops exactly two nondegenerate extrema above it; the physical risk interval has open room for multiple preimages. At most three roots follow from monotonicity intervals; three near-onset preimages are constructed by an exact artanh equation. The k=1 case is checked without division by 1-k. The endpoint third derivative is 32, giving inverse exponent 1/3. A standalone checker confirms the determinant factor and a physical high-precision witness; finite tests are not substitutes for the proof.

value.rationale: The 2026 study reports complicated competing attractors and crises but lacks an analytic parameter boundary for global one-step invertibility. Determining a complete smooth-embedding versus genuine physical two-fold phase diagram, its sharp cubic endpoint, and local three-preimage onset is a natural structural question: inverse multiplicity is directly relevant to basin folding and inverse iteration. It is not presented as a discovery of general fold theory or as proof of chaos.
